audit_notes: Model: anti-plane (streamwise) shear displacement w of the soft silicone between two streamwise ribs, x = spanwise coordinate normalized by rib_pitch, y = depth normalized by coating_thickness (base at 0, wetted surface at 1). Laplace equation in physical coordinates (1/p^2) w_xx + (1/t^2) w_yy = 0 is correct for a homogeneous soft layer. Simplification: ribs are treated as rigid and full height (clamped at x=0,1 for all y), whereas the proposal has ribs to 60% height; the model therefore overstates the stiffening (conservative for fouling release). Analytical series solution: mean surface compliance C = (t/G) * sum_odd 8/(n^2 pi^2) * tanh(n pi t/p)/(n pi t/p); for t/p = 2 this gives 0.136 t/G = 2.7e-9 m/Pa. IMPORTANT PHYSICAL FINDING: ribs aligned with the flow restrain streamwise shear displacement just as much as spanwise, because each rib is a stiff wall parallel to the displacement; the claimed 'streamwise compliant, spanwise stiff' anisotropy does not follow from streamwise ribs (it would need ribs that bend, e.g. thin inclined lamellae). The ribs reduce the parent's compliance ~2.3x (6.3e-9 -> 2.7e-9 m/Pa). Fouling release metric: sigma_c = sqrt(2 w_a / C). Baseline: standard silicone foul-release coating (t = 0.3 mm, G = 0.33 MPa) without ribs, represented by rib_pitch = 0.05 m (p >> t, side clamping negligible): C ~ 9.1e-10 m/Pa. Expected gain ~42% lower detachment stress, again a fouling-release gain, not a drag gain; the drag estimate (1%) is not modelled and the dynamic-slip argument in the proposal shows the slip contribution is ~1e-5 wall units. Dimensionless: t/p = 2, G_rib/G_soft = 200, surface strain tau/G = 1.8e-4, U/c_s = 7/9.5 = 0.74. Structural: stresses are tiny; rib-to-soft interfaces are potential debond sites but the keying improves tear arrest. Solver: 2D linear elliptic -> pinn (FDM/analytical reference).

independent_var.label: Normalized spanwise position between ribs / normalized depth

performance_gain.label: Reduction of fouling detachment stress vs standard foul-release coating

baseline_description: Standard clean silicone foul-release coating, 0.3 mm, E ~ 1 MPa, no ribs
